Resource Profile: MII PR Person Allergy Intolerance

Official URL: https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/modul-person/StructureDefinition/AllergieUnvertraeglichkeit Version: 2027.0.0-ballot
Active as of 2026-09-04 Computable Name: MII_PR_Person_AllergieUnvertraeglichkeit

This profile describes an allergy or intolerance in the Medical Informatics Initiative.

The MII AllergyIntolerance profile is a new addition to the Person module and aims to align the representation of patient-related allergies and intolerances with

  • IPS 2.0.1,
  • ISiK 6.0.0,
  • and HL7 Europe Base 2.0.0

Terminology

code.coding:snomed-ct and reaction.manifestation.coding:snomed-ct are bound extensible to the ValueSets of causative substances and manifestations that mio42 GmbH developed together with BfArM (KBV_VS_AllergyIntolerance_Substance_SNOMED_CT and KBV_VS_AllergyIntolerance_Manifestation_SNOMED_CT, version 1.0.0), as in ISiK. The SNOMED CT slices are optional: allergies documented only with other codes, for example ATC, remain valid. The ValueSets are published in the package kbv.all.terminology.allergyintolerance 1.0.0, which is only available on the BfArM ZTS after accepting its download conditions.

Onset and end as life phase

If onset or end are only known as a life phase (for example childhood), the extension Lebensphase from the German Base Profiles can be used on onsetRange and on extension:abatement.valueRange, as in the Condition profile. The extension's context does not allow Age.

Usages:

  • Examples for this Profile: AllergyIntolerance/mii-exa-person-allergyintolerance-1
  • CapabilityStatements using this Profile: MII CPS Person CapabilityStatement

You can also check for usages in the FHIR IG Statistics
